visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a light blue denim jacket over a white shirt, peeks cautiously around a beige tiled wall. He holds a red-and-yellow bowl of Wei Wei A instant noodles. His expression is suspicious and sneaky, looking into a modern indoor corridor. (2) Close-up shots show the man sitting at a wooden table in a brightly lit living room. His hands tear open a silver seasoning packet and pour it into the noodles. He places wooden chopsticks on top of the lid, waiting for it to cook. (3) A second character appears: a man in a black bodysuit, wearing a white yarn wig, a black hat, and fake elf ears (the 'noodle elf'). He stops the first man's chopsticks and begins eating the noodles himself with an exaggerated, joyful expression. (4) The man is shown opening a nearly empty refrigerator with a few beverage cans inside. He pulls out a single green lime. He is then seen squeezing the lime juice directly into the bowl of instant noodles on the table. (5) The noodle elf tastes the lime-infused noodles, showing wide eyes and a shocked, delighted face. He continues eating vigorously. Text overlays in various styles appear throughout these interactions. (6) The elf character gives a thumbs-up and speaks to the man before turning and walking away. The man looks at his smartphone with a confused and somewhat annoyed expression. (7) The final scene is a high-energy graphic montage featuring images of Wei Wei A Spare Rib Chicken noodles, a noodle-filled bread bun, and a chicken breast product, accompanied by colorful slogan text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Sneaky, low-intensity pizzicato-style BGM plays. Faint thudding footsteps (incidental noise) accompany the man's stealthy movements. (2) A sharp 'crinkle' SFX of plastic tearing is followed immediately by a bright, high-frequency 'Ding' bell sound as the noodle bowl is shown. (3) A loud vocal exclamation '住手!' (Stop!) triggers a synthesizer riser SFX. The BGM shifts to a light, bouncy acoustic track with piano and guitar. (4) Fast-paced comedic dialogue begins between Voice 1 (Man) and Voice 2 (Elf). Voice 2 is high-pitched with exaggerated energy. (5) A 'Whoosh' transition SFX occurs, leading to an energetic brass and drum section. The mechanical sound of a refrigerator door opening is clearly audible. (6) Prominent slurping SFX (wet, percussive) are heard as the elf eats. The BGM increases in volume and harmonic complexity. (7) BGM shifts to a sentimental, slow-tempo piano and string melody as Voice 2 delivers a speech about 'happiness.' (8) An aggressive impact SFX (Boom) introduces a high-energy announcer voice (Voice 3). The audio features driving electronic beats and multiple metallic 'shing' and 'hit' SFX for a commercial finale.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Wei Wei A (味味A) Spare Rib Chicken instant noodles by showing a creative way to eat them (adding lime) through a comedic sketch involving a mythical 'noodle elf'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product display, brand slogans, and a final commercial segment showing multiple brand products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy, meme-style editing rhythm characteristic of social media creators. The interplay between the mundane act of cooking and the absurd 'noodle elf' persona creates a memorable brand association.
